sections.title: Executive conclusion
sections.kicker: Evidence does not support a comparative conclusion

blocks.title: Key judgment — Coverage
blocks.text: Observation: Only one of four portfolio-fit inputs is available [S1]. Why it matters: Diversification benefit cannot be estimated. Uncertainty: Missing series may change the correlation. What would change the view: Return series for the manager and the portfolio.

blocks.title: Key judgment — Benchmarks
blocks.text: Observation: The benchmark match is suggested, not confirmed [S1]. Why it matters: Fit is judged against the sleeve benchmark. Uncertainty: Mandate fit is unconfirmed. What would change the view: A confirmed benchmark mapping.

blocks.title: Key judgment — Reliability
blocks.text: Observation: Fit across market regimes was not tested [S1]. Why it matters: A manager can diversify in one regime and not another. Uncertainty: Results may depend on the window. What would change the view: A regime-split analysis.
